digest.component_or_area: reconciler mutation payload contract and typed cutover architecture
propositions: Mutation.payload remains untyped Mapping[str, Any] while MutationDirection and MutationAction are typed, creating a serialization and validation gap that blocks typed cutover and allows invalid field/action combinations
Current architecture has duplicate CREATE payload shapes, legacy batch-dict dispatch coexistence, and string/monkeypatch consumers that make mutation semantics non-local and comparison ambiguous

Producer-input seams (_compute_outbound_update_mutation 23-parameter, compute_update_fields 14-value, diff_canonical_fields 11-value) lack cohesive ownership boundaries, risking wrapper proliferation and Observation/TicketPlan duplication during typed migration

Canonical serialization representation must be distinguished from comparison-only normalization to preserve manifest compatibility while enabling reliable shadow/live contrast without dual-send to production

Dead enum pairs (inbound, delete) and (inbound, probe) must be explicitly removed and migration sequencing (expand→compare→cut→delete) must name _mutation_to_batch_dict, legacy dispatch, and obsolete re-exports as deletion targets
